custody_problems: auditor code revision is not an independently reviewed revision
audit is not running as the designated auditor account (alessbarb)
auditor account is also a developer account
no auditor signing key was provided

findings.detail: change to audit, governance or CI control requires disposition by separate authority
test skip or expected failure added: @pytest.mark.skipif(

limitations: Auditor checks run only Python argv defined by the trusted policy; PostgreSQL integration tests are skipped inside the network-less sandbox and are covered only by implementer-controlled CI.
CI check-runs are recorded as implementer-controlled inputs, not as independent evidence.
Adversarial rules are deterministic path and test-weakening heuristics, not a semantic security review.
The ledger hash chain is unkeyed: it detects accidental corruption only; protection against anyone able to write the file (for example to drop a veto) comes solely from auditor-account file custody.
The gate's implementer identity comes from the caller; it must be supplied by the merge authority, not by the implementer.
residual_risks: independence holds only while auditor account custody holds
scope: exact candidate tree against base; local, inert, disposable
